Nandi Hills sunrise it is. It's about 60 km from Bengaluru, so plan to leave around 3:30 AM to be up there before first light.

Carry a jacket, since it's cold and windy at the top before sunrise.
Weekends get crowded, so an early start also helps with parking and the view.
Check the entry timings and the weather before you go, as I haven't looked either up.
